entities.summary: Berlinde De Bruyckere is a Belgian contemporary artist who works in sculpture and installation. Her sculptures use body-like forms. Her work is influenced by religious imagery, mythology, and the Flemish Renaissance. Themes in her artwork display human experience, existence, and raw emotion.
